highlights.title: Celestial Summons (Devas & Planetars)
highlights.summary: Rebalanced 3e-grounded Devas and Planetars without permanent Haste, clearer spellbooks, player spell selection, and a 1 Deva + 1 Planetar party cap.
bullets: Casting time is 1 round (9), range 30 ft., lasting 3 turns for Devas and 2 turns for Planetars.
Planetars have 18 HD and 171 HP (instead of permanent Haste); Devas have 14 HD and 136 HP; every listed weapon hit/status matches in-game numbers.
Both carry BOTH gender so Death Spell cannot kill a creature listed as death-magic immune, and you control which spells they cast.
Party cap allows up to one Deva (or Fallen Deva) and one Planetar (or Dark Planetar) simultaneously across Clerics, Paladins, and Wizards.
openQuestions: Are the new 3e-inspired stats, 2–3 turn durations, and removal of permanent Planetar Haste strong enough against high-level ToB encounters without trivializing fights?
Should any spells be swapped on the Deva or Planetar level-by-level spell lists, or should the 1 Deva + 1 Planetar limit work differently?

highlights.title: Typed Buff Stacking & Exclusive Families
highlights.summary: Six clear buff types (Morale, Favor, Luck, Dodge, Deflection, Curse) plus exclusive Transformation and Regeneration families end bloated additive stacking while keeping recasts smooth.
bullets: For each stat and type, the strongest bonus and strongest penalty apply together; suppressed buffs stay on the target and resume if the stronger buff expires.
Haste, Improved Haste, and Righteous Wrath of the Faithful coexist peacefully: only one extra attack counts at a time (EEex).
Strength-setting spells (Strength, Strength of One, Divine Power, Righteous Magic, Champion's Strength, Blood/Animal Rage) set a minimum floor instead of erasing gear Strength.

highlights.title: Healing & Cause Wounds Scaling
highlights.summary: Cure and Cause Wounds scale with real die-plus-flat healing, streamlined casting times, and clean undead reciprocity.
bullets: Cure Light (1d8+5, CT 4), Moderate (2d8+4, CT 4), Medium (2d8+7, CT 4), Serious (3d8+7, CT 6), Critical (4d8+12, CT 7), and Mass Cure (1d8+1/level, CT 4).
Heal drops to casting time 6 (full HP + disease/blindness/Feeblemind cure); Mass Regenerate adds 2 HP/round (1 HP/3s) party regeneration at level 5.
Cause Wounds mirror Cure Wounds numbers and heal undead instead of harming them; Slow Poison keeps instant poison removal like the base game.

highlights.title: Pierce Magic, Magic Resistance & Dispelling Screen
highlights.summary: Pierce Magic scales off half the target's current MR, Dispelling Screen absorbs one Breach or Dispel, and Protection vs. Breach follows clear rules.
bullets: Pierce Magic reduces target Magic Resistance by half its current value rounded down (min 10, max 40 points) for 5 rounds when EEex is active.
Dispelling Screen blocks one Dispel/Remove Magic or Breach (stripping the screen first) across arcane and divine dispel abilities.
Minor Spell Deflection caps cleanly at spell level 4; Dispel Magic & Remove Magic also destroy summoned Nishruu and Hakeashar and dispellable created weapons.

highlights.title: Polymorph Self, Shapechange & Crowd Control Rules
highlights.summary: 6 rebuilt Polymorph Self forms and 6 Shapechange forms with exact combat numbers, plus Wake on Damage on sleep/stun effects and Breath saves on big AoE blasts.
bullets: Polymorph Self forms (Hill Giant, Ogre Mage, Giant Spider, Mustard Jelly, Hell Hound, Rat) & Shapechange forms (Greater Wolfwere, Iron Golem, Mind Flayer, Earth Elemental, Death Knight, Greater Basilisk) list exact AC, THAC0, APR, damage, resistances, and special abilities.
Sleep, Color Spray, Command, Greater Command, Power Word: Sleep, Stinking Cloud, Sphere of Chaos, and Emotion: Hopelessness wake victims when damaged.
Fireball, Delayed Blast Fireball, and Cone of Cold roll against Breath instead of Spell; Web, Grease, Entangle, and Stinking Cloud enforce logical creature immunities.

highlights.title: Protagonist Petrification/Imprisonment, Simulacrum & Familiars
highlights.summary: Petrification or Imprisonment on the main character no longer triggers an instant game over while companions remain active, plus cleaner Simulacrum and EET Find Familiar.
bullets: If companions remain able to act and carry or can reach a real cure (Stone to Flesh / Freedom), the party can carry on and rescue the protagonist; real dead ends still end cleanly.
Simulacrum clones keep their real class/kit innates and HLAs (under EEex) instead of empty or infinite-item exploits; Project Image disables quick-slot items and innates.
Find Familiar belongs to Universal so specialists can cast it, with campaign HP tiers clearly listed across BG1, SoD, SoA, and ToB.

systemRules.title: AoE Damage Bypasses Mirror Image
systemRules.summary: Area-of-effect spell and item damage (Fireball, Skull Trap, Horrid Wilting, Breath weapons, Traps, etc.) ignores Mirror Image decoys while single-target rays still strip images.

systemRules.title: Dispel Destroys Created Weapons & Nishruu/Hakeashar
systemRules.summary: Dispel Magic, Remove Magic, Inquisitor Dispel, and Magic-Eating dispels now strip created spell weapons (Flame Blade, Phantom Blade, Minute Meteors, etc.) and destroy summoned Nishruu/Hakeashar.

systemRules.title: Universal Utility Schools & Specialist Access
systemRules.summary: Find Familiar, Minor Sequencer, Contingency, Spell Sequencer, Spell Trigger, and Chain Contingency belong to the Universal school with specialist exclusions cleared on spells and scrolls. Cloud spells move to Conjuration; Power Word: Sleep moves to Enchantment.

systemRules.title: Web, Grease, Entangle & Stinking Cloud Immunities
systemRules.summary: Incorporeal spirits, dragons, true beholders, mephits, ethereal/huge threats follow clearer terrain and cloud immunities; undead, constructs, oozes, and poison-immune creatures ignore Stinking Cloud.

systemRules.title: Druid Sphere & Three New Druid Spells
systemRules.summary: Barkskin, Shillelagh, Flame Blade, Animal Summoning I–III, and Conjure Animals are restricted to Druids and Rangers; Faerie Fire (L1), Icelance (L3), and Conjure Air Elemental (L6) expand the druid repertoire.
